items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: Virgil Thompson came up to the country to hang out

ctx.x: So think about what the east coast was like in those days, and who was there. We were about a half a mile from Benny Goodman’s house in Connecticut. We were — in urban terms say blocks, but the reality was that we were a large hayfield away from John Hammond’s house. Leonard Bernstein was, you know a drive away. He wasn’t that close but he wasn’t that far. John Hersey was around there someplace, the author. The next door neighbors included a painter whose reputation is kind of gone now, but Jean Jackson who was…
